packageRules.description: Never touch peerDependencies. The supported React range is a published API contract, not a dependency to keep current.
Leave the node version alone. Both .nvmrc and the node-version input in .github/actions/install pin the major line ('24') on purpose; Renovate would rewrite them to an exact 24.x.y.
Match the minimumReleaseAge (10080 minutes) in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Without this, Renovate proposes versions that pnpm itself refuses to resolve, and the lockfile update fails.
Let pnpm enforce minimumReleaseAge during lockfile maintenance.

Keep the pnpm toolchain bump on its own PR. Renovate rewrites the packageManager pin via `corepack use`, which regenerates the sha512 hash. The pnpm gate above does not apply here — corepack installs the binary, it is not resolved from the registry by pnpm.
Group non-major devDependency updates together while keeping major upgrades reviewable separately.
